line_reserved_detail: Engineering has control for planned work
repair_in_progress_detail: Engineer is working on the line
settings_check_whether_a_newer_version_h: Check whether a newer version has been published
settings_connector_files_beside_the_appl: Connector files beside the application are discovered and validated automatically. Settings never edits their credentials, endpoints, mappings, or capabilities.
settings_creates_a_new_diagnostic_only_r: Creates a new diagnostic-only REST connector. Existing files are never changed. Add workflow operations manually after the connection test passes.
settings_leave_unused_rows_blank_at_leas:
Leave unused rows blank. At least one and at most four custom types are allowed.
OTHERS is always added automatically as the final option.
settings_place_connector_json_connector_: Place connector.json, *.connector.json, connector-*.json, or connector_*.json beside the application, then reopen Settings.
settings_product_and_licensing_identity_: Product and licensing identity is fixed by the validated build profile.
settings_software_updates_description: Software is installed only from a signed update drive after administrator authorization. The release source and the accepted signing keys are fixed when the application is built and cannot be changed here.
settings_use_any_user_defined_name_such: Use any user-defined name, such as Station A, Robot 3, Inspection, or Pack-out.
settings_use_six_digit_hexadecimal_color: Use six-digit hexadecimal colors, for example #246BFD.
settings_validation: All changes are validated before saving
settings_validation_is_offline_and_makes: Validation is offline and makes no external request. Selecting a file activates it after Save; the connector remains the source of all credentials and technical setup.
touch_stations_prompt: TOUCH ONE OR MORE STATIONS TO IDENTIFY THE AFFECTED AREA
update_need_help: Need help?  Follow the update guide on the project page, or contact {maintainer} at {email}.
update_no_activity: No update activity has been recorded
update_no_activity_detail: This terminal has not installed or restored a version since the update record was created. Every future installation, automatic recovery, and rollback is listed here and written to the update log.
update_no_capabilities: This build does not carry a recorded capability list.
update_none_known_detail: Nothing is waiting to be installed on this terminal and no newer release has been confirmed. When a new version is published, its changes are listed here before anything is installed.
update_publish_unconfirmed: This terminal could not confirm the published version. Check the project releases page.
update_recent_activity: RECENT UPDATE ACTIVITY ON THIS TERMINAL
update_step_download: 1.  Download the release and its checksum from  {url}
update_step_insert: 3.  Plug the drive into this terminal. It verifies the package itself, then an administrator authorizes the installation here.
update_step_prepare: 2.  Format a USB drive with the volume label  {label}  and copy the  {folder}  folder to it.
update_verified_here: Verified on this terminal • signature key {key} • SHA-256 {digest}…
update_where_from_detail: Releases are published by {maintainer} at {url}. This terminal never downloads software on its own: an update always arrives on a verified USB drive and is installed only after an administrator authorizes it here.
settings_local_password_active: An installation-specific password is set. Changes take effect immediately and survive software updates.
settings_initial_password_active: The initial build password is active. The standard release password is public: change it before production use.
settings_password_saved: Password saved immediately. Other Settings edits are still unsaved.
